recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls 3-Ways (Pumpkin Spice, Strawberry Nutella, Classic)
ingredients: 70 g unsalted butter, room temperature (5 tbsp)
70 g unsalted butter, room temperature (5 tbsp)
1 oz freeze dried strawberries, ground into powder
60 g unsalted butter, room temperature (1/4 cup)
80 g unsalted butter, room temperature (1/3 cup)
115 g cream cheese, room temperature (1/2 block)
instructions: For Pumpkin Spice:
For the Tangzhong Starter
In a small saucepan, whisk together water and flour over medium heat until thickened and reaching 175°F (80°C), like frosting. Remove from heat. - 150 ml water - 30 g all purpose flour
For the Dough

Transfer the Tangzhong to the bowl of a stand mixer. Add cold buttermilk in small splashes while mixing. Add flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and beaten eggs. Knead on low, then medium, for 2 minutes. If the dough is too wet, add flour 1 tbsp at a time. Once combined, add butter, one tbsp at a time. Knead for 6 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. - For the Tangzhong Starter - 165 ml cold buttermilk - 450 g all purpose flour - 50 g granulated sugar - 2 tsp kosher salt - 2 ¼ tsp instant yeast (1 packet) - 2 large eggs - 70 g unsalted butter room temperature (5 tbsp)
Transfer dough to an oiled container. Cover and let rise for 1-2 hours until doubled in size. For faster proofing, place in an oven with the light on (about 80°F/27°C).
For the Pumpkin Spice Mixture

In a mixing bowl, whisk all ingredients together until homogenous. - 50 g light brown sugar - 80 g granulated sugar - 1 tbsp ground cinnamon - 1 tsp ground ginger - ½ tsp ground cardamom - ¼ tsp allspice - ¼ tsp kosher salt - ⅛ tsp ground cloves - ½ tsp freshly grated nutmeg
For the Assembly

Roll out the dough into a 12x20-inch (30x50 cm) rectangle. Spread pumpkin puree evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border. Sprinkle the pumpkin spice mixture evenly over the puree. - For the Dough - 250 g pumpkin puree - For the Pumpkin Spice Mixture
Roll the dough tightly from the bottom edge upward. Slice into 12 pieces and arrange in a prepared 9x13-inch (23x33 cm) pan. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Brush the tops with melted butter. Bake for 25 minutes, rotating halfway.
For the Frosting

Dissolve instant coffee in heavy cream. Beat powdered sugar, butter, cream cheese, and salt until smooth, then add the coffee-cream mixture until frosting is creamy. - 200 g powdered sugar - 80 g unsalted butter room temperature - 115 g cream cheese room temperature - ½ tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp instant coffee - 2 tbsp heavy cream
Spread the frosting over warm rolls.
For Strawberry Nutella:
For the Tangzhong Starter
In a small saucepan, whisk together water and flour over medium heat until thickened and reaching 175°F (80°C), like frosting. Remove from heat. - 150 ml water - 30 g all purpose flour
For the Dough

Transfer the Tangzhong to the bowl of a stand mixer. Add cold buttermilk in small splashes while mixing. Add flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and beaten eggs. Knead on low, then medium, for 2 minutes. If the dough is too wet, add flour 1 tbsp at a time. Once combined, add butter, one tbsp at a time. Knead for 6 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. - For the Tangzhong Starter - 165 ml cold buttermilk - 450 g all purpose flour - 50 g granulated sugar - 2 tsp kosher salt - 2 ¼ tsp instant yeast - 2 large eggs - 70 g unsalted butter room temperature (5 tbsp)
Transfer dough to an oiled container. Cover and let rise for 1-2 hours until doubled in size. For faster proofing, place in an oven with the light on (about 80°F/27°C).
Roll out the dough into a 12x20-inch (30x50 cm) rectangle. Spread Nutella evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border at the top edge. - For the Dough - 200 g Nutella

Roll the dough tightly from the bottom edge upward. Slice into 12 pieces, wiping your knife between cuts. Arrange in a prepared 9x13-inch (23x33 cm) pan. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake for 25 minutes, rotating halfway, until rolls are golden and internal temperature reaches 195°F (90°C).
For the Frosting

In a food processor, grind freeze-dried strawberries into powder. Beat powdered sugar, butter, cream cheese, and salt until smooth. Add strawberry powder and heavy cream until the frosting reaches a smooth, spreadable consistency. - 1 oz freeze dried strawberries ground into powder - 200 g powdered sugar - 80 g unsalted butter room temperature - 115 g cream cheese room temperature - ½ tsp kosher salt - ½ cup heavy cream
Spread the frosting over warm rolls. - For the Frosting
For Classic:
For the Tangzhong Starter
In a small saucepan, whisk together water and flour over medium heat until thickened and reaching 175°F (80°C), like frosting. Remove from heat. - 150 ml water - 30 g all purpose flour
For the Dough

Transfer the Tangzhong to the bowl of a stand mixer. Add cold buttermilk in small splashes while mixing. Add flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and beaten eggs. Knead on low, then medium, for 2 minutes. If the dough is too wet, add flour 1 tbsp at a time. Once combined, add butter, one tbsp at a time. Knead for 6 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. - For the Tangzhong Starter - 165 ml cold buttermilk - 450 g all purpose flour - 50 g granulated sugar - 2 tsp kosher salt - 2 ¼ tsp instant yeast - 2 large eggs - 60 g unsalted butter room temperature (1/4 cup)
Transfer dough to an oiled container. Cover and let rise for 1-2 hours until doubled in size. For faster proofing, place in an oven with the light on (about 80°F/27°C). - For the Dough
For the Cinnamon Sugar Mixture
In a mixing bowl whisk all cinnamon sugar mixture ingredients together until homogenous. - 80 g granulated sugar (1/3 cup) - 50 g light brown sugar (1/4 cup) - 1 ½ tbsp ground cinnamon
For the Assembly

Turn the dough onto an oiled surface. Roll into a 12x20-inch (30x50 cm) rectangle. Spread butter over the surface, then sprinkle with the cinnamon-sugar mixture. - For the Dough - For the Cinnamon Sugar Mixture

Roll the dough tightly from the bottom edge upward. Slice into 12 pieces and arrange in a prepared 9x13-inch (23x33 cm) pan. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise for 1 hour (or refrigerate overnight and let sit at room temperature for 1 hour before baking). - For the Dough
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake for 25 minutes, rotating halfway, until rolls are golden and internal temperature reaches 195°F (90°C).
For the Frosting

Beat powdered sugar, butter, cream cheese, and salt until smooth. Add heavy cream to desired consistency. Spread over warm rolls. - 200 g powdered sugar (1 1/2 cups) - 80 g unsalted butter room temperature (1/3 cup) - 115 g cream cheese room temperature (1/2 block) - ½ tsp kosher salt - 1 ½ tbsp heavy cream
